items.title: QI Brain — session logging
items.detail: Register each NEXUS synthesis in the Brain DB via qi.log_session(): prompt, providers used, routing mode, elapsed time, judge verdict. Gives the ecosystem cross-project visibility into what NEXUS is being asked. Not yet wired.

items.title: QI Brain — decision logging
items.detail: Log significant orchestration decisions (which routing mode won, judge best-pick, provider failures, model swaps) via qi.log_decision() so model-selection learning is shared across projects.

items.title: Maia synthesis routing
items.detail: Wire Maia's LLM chain to optionally route complex queries to POST /synthesize for multi-AI synthesis. Client stub exists at C:\QI\nexus_client.py — make it a selectable routing mode in Maia.

items.title: QI Standards compliance audit
items.detail: Run qi_validator.py --project nexus. Reconcile the legacy api/main.py CORS import path (C:\QI\ECOSYSTEM) with the migrated C:\QIH\ecosystem location, confirm folder layout, and refresh QI_Service_Registry.md entries.

items.title: Per-session cost & token tracking
items.detail: Record per-provider token usage and estimated cost for each synthesis. Surface in History and feed QI Brain usage stats. No cost tracking exists at the NEXUS level today.

items.title: Adaptive provider selection
items.detail: Use Bench history (GET /bench/recommend) to auto-route a query to the cheapest competent provider for its task class — mirroring Maia's model-delegation policy and avoiding burning premium models on trivial prompts.

items.title: Re-enable / rotate cloud providers
items.detail: Gemini is disabled after free-tier quota exhaustion (replaced by local gemma4:26b). Add a quota-aware health check that auto-disables a provider on repeated 429s and re-enables on renewal, instead of manual config edits.

items.title: Scout relevance & novelty scoring
items.detail: Score digest items by relevance and novelty (the llm_scores / scout_items.score columns already exist but are unused) and surface highest-signal items first rather than reverse-chronological.

items.title: Scheduled regression runs
items.detail: Register Bench suites as recurring scheduled jobs so every provider is re-benchmarked nightly/weekly and score drift is caught automatically. Build on the existing scheduled_jobs + bench_provider_runs tables.

items.title: Use-case-tagged recommendations
items.detail: Bench cases carry a category; extend recommend() to rank providers per category (code, reasoning, summarization) so /bench/recommend?use_case=code returns the right model, not just the global best.

items.title: Expand the starter suite
items.detail: Grow the seeded 5-case Starter Regression suite toward the originally envisioned 200+ cases across chat/code/reasoning/translation/sentiment, tagged by target QI app.

items.title: API authentication
items.detail: Add Bearer-token auth to the FastAPI layer. NEXUS is currently single-user / local-only behind a Cloudflare tunnel — auth is required before any wider exposure.

items.title: Rate limiting & per-user isolation
items.detail: Throttle requests and isolate sessions per caller so one client can't exhaust provider quotas or read another's history.

items.title: Regression test coverage
items.detail: Expand regression_test.py / tests/test_smoke.py to cover all routing modes, both judge modes, a full Scout cycle, and provider-failure paths; wire into a nightly run.

items.title: Session table growth management
items.detail: 5,000+ sessions and 13,000+ scout_items are accumulating. Add a retention/archival policy (the bulk-delete endpoint exists) and periodic VACUUM to keep nexus.db (currently ~24 MB) lean.

items.title: Provider DB seed vs config drift
items.detail: The providers DB table still holds the original seed (e.g. 'ChatGPT Plus', no gemma4) while providers.json is the live source. Reconcile or retire the DB seed to avoid confusion.

items.title: Health dashboard endpoint
items.detail: Add a richer /status-style endpoint exposing live provider reachability, Scout last-run times, RAG entry count, and scheduler job list for the QI Hive Mission Control board.
